questions.question: A library had 425 books. It received 168 more books. How many books does it have now?
A farmer picked 850 apples. He sold 375 apples. How many apples are left?
Mia has 245 stickers. Her friend gives her 189 more. How many stickers does Mia have now?
A tank contained 700 liters of water. 248 liters were used. How many liters remain?
The school collected 356 cans on Monday and 287 cans on Tuesday. How many cans were collected altogether?
A store sold 235 toys in the morning and 178 toys in the afternoon. If it started with 600 toys, how many toys are left?
Tom had 325 marbles. He won 146 more and then gave away 189. How many marbles does he have now?
A train carried 478 passengers. 129 got off at one station and 85 got off at the next station. How many passengers remain on the train?
Emma saved $245 in January, $178 in February, and $129 in March. How much did she save altogether?
A ribbon is 950 cm long. 275 cm is cut off, then another 185 cm is cut off. How much ribbon remains?
